kjv: whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause
mine: everyone who is angry with his brother
note: TR adds "eike" ("without a cause"), absent from P64, Sinaiticus and Vaticanus; the addition softens an absolute prohibition of anger.

kjv: it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not commit adultery
mine: it was said, 'You shall not commit adultery.'
note: TR adds "tois archaiois" ("by/to them of old") by assimilation to 5:21 and 5:33.

kjv: bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you
mine: pray for those who persecute you
note: TR expands the saying with phrases from Luke 6:27-28 ("eulogeite tous katarōmenous ... epēreazontōn"); the shorter text is in Sinaiticus and Vaticanus.

kjv: do not even the publicans so
mine: Do not even the Gentiles do the same
note: TR repeats "telōnai" (tax collectors) from 5:46; the earliest manuscripts read "ethnikoi" (Gentiles).
geenna tou pyros names the valley of Hinnom as the place of final judgment; KJV's "hell" merges it with hades and the OT Sheol (systematic in KJV).
